title: A protein that fuels cancer could also be the key to fighting it
caption:
Could a protein that helps cancer grow be the secret to stopping it? Scientists at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory found that activating a specific metabolic protein in immune cells makes them better at burning fat and fighting tumors.

Source: Sciencedaily - A protein that fuels cancer could also be the key to fighting it

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261015073203.htm
